title: 2.3 Fungi
description: Fungal structure, reproduction, nutrition and the roles of yeasts, moulds and mushrooms. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Fungus?

A eukaryotic organism that absorbs nutrients from its surroundings
